offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells spine implants and bone graft and orthobiologic products used by spine surgeons in hospitals and surgery centers. Products are sold directly to hospitals and through independent distributors and sales agents.

primary_products.value: spinal fusion implants; bone graft substitutes; allograft tissue; orthobiologic products; spinal fixation systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, spine surgeons, ambulatory surgery centers, distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: implants, biologic grafts and instruments sold to hospitals and surgeons

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes implants and tissue products, sold to hospitals and distributors; brand owner: markets proprietary spine and biologic product lines under its own brands

geography_served.value: US national: sales across the United States, with some international distribution

specialization.value: related lines: spine implants, bone graft and orthobiologic products sold to the same spine surgeon customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales representatives calling on hospitals and surgeons; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and sales agents covering regional markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and tissue products needing FDA clearance or approval and tissue establishment registration

P2.3: Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for Biofilm Engineering. We evolved into Xtant Medical, where today, we deliver a comprehensive biologics and fixation portfolio while staying true to our roots: honoring donors, serving patients, and innovating for the future. Our biologics are processed in a dedicated, state-of-the-art facility using patented technologies like BacteRinse™ to preserve essential growth factors while ensuring safety and clinical reliability. This focus allows us to honor every donor gift with the highest standards of quality and respect.
